segments.name: packaging and test services
segments.description: Provides outsourced semiconductor packaging and test services to chip makers.
segments.evidence: Business Segments, Customer Concentrations and Geographic Information We operate as a single operating segment as managed by our Chief Executive Officer, who is considered our chief operating decision maker ("CODM").

revenueModel.text: Chip makers, fabless semiconductor companies, equipment makers and foundries pay for packaging and test.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide our services to integrated device manufacturers ("IDMs"), "fabless" semiconductor companies, original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs") and contract foundries.
